title: Your Claude Check bookmarks, triaged: 65 cards, 117 tickers, 12 new favourites
what: Every bookmark as a card with the part of Scintilla it touches and one proposed step. Names mentioned twice or more are in FAV; 34 names the price service does not carry yet wait with a proposed cohort.

title: Earnings: moved dates retired, no Dividends tab, the tape leans in as a report nears
what: 53 stale dates marked retired (none deleted), so '8 past dates without results' is gone. The bottom tape goes from 'in 12 days' to 'tomorrow after the close' to the result.

title: Station: the dock uses its width, no shading under the lines, X pauses under your pointer
what: ES and NQ draw on TradingView instead of saying 'not served'. The X pane relinks by itself when its picture freezes and says live / paused / relinking. BACK and CLOSE on four pages you open by hand.

title: EVENTS: earnings as a tape you scroll through time
what: One bar per trading day, as tall as the day's reports, cyan to orange to red; drag back into history or ahead to November's peak (38 on 4 Nov). Tap a bar for that day.

title: SENTIMENT: CNN's own dial, live VIX, and how every reading is built
what: Dials in the publishers' colours with last week and month beside them. A HOW IT IS BUILT tab walks from the number down to the words that scored it, green and red. Headlines scored word by word; StockTwits gone.

title: Context Lens on the Station's own charts, up, down and sideways
what: Six real cases (MU up, T down, SPY sideways, turns, a gap) drawn by the Station's chart with your clouds; where the lens sits, the corners it refused, and the knobs. No replay.

title: The library reads like the 3D workshop, and no page hides its own title
what: One scrolling page instead of six tabs that hid each other; tools as cards with a plate, a readiness word and a date; Latest as one row you push sideways. Every page the Hub opens now holds BACK / CLOSE in its own header.

title: Dashboard: cohort compare, map, rotation and relative are one set of tabs
what: Each tab owns the whole right half and the choice is remembered. Board prices on open: 9.6 s to 3.7 s (median of three rounds), by stopping four copies of the same price request from fighting.

title: SENTIMENT: the public gauges first, the voices one channel one vote
what: CNN (35, fear, with its seven parts), crypto fear & greed and VIX on top, each with its date and source. The internal 54 is gone. YouTube channels each get one vote, and the page says when they split.

title: ALLOCATION: layer three is a funnel you can watch
what: Six steps, each with how many went in and out and every name cut with the number that cut it; 118 non-picks named. MU, SMCI, SNDK and META left at 'too far above the 50-day'.

title: Six chart patterns measured: one survives, barely; RSI read in bands
what: Inverse head and shoulders passes all five tests but leaves +0.15% at 20 days. Wedges and head and shoulders fail; the flags are too few. SPY near 58 after dipping near 40 did slightly worse than an ordinary day.

title: How unusual is this reading? Tap any RSI on the board
what: SPY at 58 sits above 57% of days since 2003; at or below 40 happens about 8 times a year, and 20 days later it was higher 70% of the time. Nine readings, each against its own history.

title: EVENTS earnings: MONTH, WEEK and DAY, as your proposal said
what: The week you are in lands first; the month shows each day's load and its three biggest names (4 Nov carries 38). Tap a name for its earnings card.

title: Visual Engine is a mood board now, not a panel of toggles
what: Six live tiles, all moving on today’s numbers, no controls at all. Click one and it fills the screen with a single play/pause.

title: Tapes at one speed; no fear & greed on the board; BACK and CLOSE on every page
what: All four bottom tapes move at 45 px/s and never leave the window half empty. The strip you did not ask for is gone from the dashboard. Every page the Hub opens has BACK and CLOSE.

title: ALLOCATION: the page writes its own answer
what: How much to own, which sectors, which names, from live numbers each time it loads; every judgement is a toggle you can change.

title: SENTIMENT tab: the market, the voices and CNN, side by side
what: The market gauge (50) is kept apart from what people say (82); CNN's 35 sits beside both. Sub-tabs for news, YouTube and X.

title: Context Lens workshop, with Geiger in motion and the Visual engine
what: One page, one clock, three tabs, on real data. On play only the Geiger moves.

title: Company report, one copy: 67 sections
what: 29 on the Hub, 24 partly, 14 missing, as cards with this Latest feed. The version and test talk is gone.

title: Economic nudge to your 16 Aug prototype; EARNINGS band; tapes fold away
what: Breathes inside the hour, tightens at 10 minutes, one hard pulse at the minute; three or more on a day become a swarm. The bottom tapes fold to a lip and come back when the mouse nears the bottom.
surface: Hub · top nudge and bottom tapes

title: Hub data audit: what was right, what was wrong, where it comes from
what: The VIX and rates shown 40 days old (now live), the provider map, the Geiger's health, the oil roll.

title: YouTube: five channels connected, the dropdown switches between them
what: Personal, SCINTILLA, Soundscapes, Golf and AI Research each show their own videos; the pane checks each channel on its own.

title: X bridge 0.7.18: the Station's X pane scrolls again
what: The extension only knew the X pane's old address. Proven scrolling the live feed in Chrome; the same build is on both Macs.

title: Live macro prices on the Hub and the Station
what: VIX and the 3-month, 5-, 10- and 30-year rates had been shown from 14 Aug; oil showed an expired contract. All now live from FMP.
